subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A military helicopter/aviation operation remains the broad subject, but the sequence does not preserve a single central subject cleanly: the shirtless crewmen vanish after shot 2, shot 4 introduces multiple different helicopters, and shots 5-6 shift to an interior pilot view.

background_coherent.rationale: The airfield/ship/helicopter context is loosely related, but the setting jumps from deck-side disembarkation to a confused ship/water composite, then aerial landscape and cockpit interiors. It feels like related military-helicopter footage rather than one coherent continuous place.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Mostly matches the outdoor olive-drab helicopter with shirtless crew and vintage documentary look.
Caption describes an indoor workshop/engine bay, but the frame remains outdoors beside the helicopter.
Caption asks for a close-up spinning rotor against sky with no people, but the frame is still the helicopter side-door scene with men.
Contains a helicopter/ship-deck idea, but the image is a distorted composite and does not clearly show the described aerial takeoff sequence.
Multiple helicopters and landscape are present, but heavy ghosting/compositing artifacts undermine the formation-flight scene.
Matches cockpit interior from behind a helmeted pilot with another helicopter visible outside, though with visual artifacts.
Caption expects an exterior helicopter over terrain; frame remains a cockpit-back view similar to shot 5.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: There is real variation later from exterior deck to formation and cockpit views, but shots 0-2 collapse into the same outdoor helicopter setup despite captions requesting very different subjects, and shots 5-6 are also very similar.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sequence shows plausible progression from people boarding/disembarking near a helicopter to flight and cockpit views, with rotor motion and changing positions. However, repeated near-identical setups and composite transitions weaken continuity.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 most clearly breaks: shot 2 still shows the side-door ground scene despite its rotor caption, then shot 3 abruptly becomes a distorted ship/water/takeoff composite with no stable continuity of people, camera, or setting.

cheat_flags.rationale: Shots 0-2 reuse the same helicopter-side composition instead of following distinct captions, and shots 5-6 collapse toward the same cockpit framing. The model appears biased toward preserving a familiar helicopter shot rather than honoring requested shot changes.
